id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

orderLineReceiptId.description:
A unique identifier of this purchase order line receipt. This should be used for display purposes in the UI.
**NOTE**: This is different {#id} of this purchase order line receipt, which is system generated.

orderLine.description:
{@link PurchaseOrderLine} to which this purchase order receipt belongs to.
Every purchase order line receipt must belong to one and only one parent purchase order line.

deliveredQuantity.description: The quantity of the `item` which was delivered as part of this receipt.

deliveredDate.description:
The date and time when this order was delivered.
Deduced from the parent {@link PurchaseOrder#purchaseDate}.

title: A purchase order line receipt confirms the delivery of a given {@link PurchaseOrderLine} belonging to a {@link PurchaseOrder}.
name: PurchaseOrderLineReceipt
